title: finding(types): the Spec Main Shape Gate is red in the merge queue: objectstack#20357 retired the list view's `tabs` key, and `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` still authors `tabs`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a required gate red on every merge-queue run, with a named landing site. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`, after the merge queue ejected PR objectstack-ai/objectui#10983 (objectui#10963) for `CI_FAILURE` at 13:39Z. ⛔ Not graded here.

## What fails
- The `Spec Main Shape Gate` compiles `packages/types` against `@objectstack/spec` built from objectstack `main`. On the queue commit `2bfe567c50` for PR objectui#10983, against objectstack `6e3e5462c6`, `pnpm run type-check` exits 2:
  - `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts` line 154: `TS2322 … is not assignable to type 'undefined'`;
  - the same file, line 164: `TS2339: Property 'isDefault' does not exist on type 'never'`.
- The test is "should accept tabs configuration". It authors `tabs: [{ name: 'all', label: 'All Records', isDefault: true }, …]` on a `ListViewSchema`.

## Why
- objectstack-ai/objectstack#20357 (`6e3e5462c6`, merged 12:49Z, `feat(spec)!`) retires `ListViewSchema.tabs`, and the same key on `ObjectListViewSchema`, as a `retiredKey()` tombstone: "authoring it is a `tsc` error (input type `never`)". The prescription is to move each tab to a named `listViews` entry. The D2 conversion `view-list-tabs-removed` strips it from stored views.
- objectui declares `tabs` by reference to the spec type (`tabs?: ListViewSchema['tabs']`). Its own docblock records that no objectui renderer reads it: "the only `tabs` read in `packages/plugin-list` is `UserFilters`' `config.tabs`". So on spec `main` the fixture no longer compiles.
- The gate is in the merge queue's required set. So every queued PR is ejected until this is fixed, whatever it changes. PR objectui#10962 is in the queue now.

## Direction (for triage to grade)
- Follow the spec's retirement in objectui, so `packages/types` compiles against both the pinned 17.4.0 (which still accepts `tabs`) and spec `main`.
- At minimum, retire the "should accept tabs configuration" fixture. The protocol now refuses what it authors.
- Whether objectui also tombstones its own `tabs` re-declaration now, or at the pin bump, is for the dispatch to measure against the census pins. The objectui#7779 / #7923 "objectui declares every LIVE protocol key" rows care which one.
- Grep for other `tabs` authoring on a list view: tests, docs, examples.
- Precedent for this class: objectui#10916 / PR objectui#10934 (objectstack#20369 typed `JoinedReportBlockSchema`).

## Dedupe
A search of objectui issues ("Spec Main Shape Gate", `tabs`, `p1-spec-alignment`, objectstack 20357) found only the closed precedents objectui#10916, #10287 and #10229.
